title: Intravenous Immune Globulin for the Treatment of Autoimmune Mucocutaneous Blistering Diseases
item_service_description: <p>   Intravenous immune globulin (IVIg) is a blood product prepared from the pooled plasma of donors. It has been used to treat a variety of autoimmune diseases, including mucocutaneous blistering diseases. It has fewer side effects than steroids or immunosuppressive agents.</p>
